name: A Good Head On Your Shoulders
label: Quest
description: A Good Head On Your Shoulders: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It seems as if master had this planned from the start. I was not taught to create the items which you learned to create and you were not taught the items which I learned to create.
The master is wise, friend. We shall teach each other!
Show me how to make a mithril coif and ornate mithril shoulders and I shall show you how to create an ornate mithril helm.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you completed the crafting of the items, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent! A fair tradeoff, if I do say so myself. Watch and learn, friend!
